rows.en:
You look exactly like a Nyan-Nyan waitress,
so as everyday clothes, it's a bit...
rows.notes: Both genders. Klan is female, so 'waitress'.

rows.en: Wha-?!
rows.notes: x5: Klan here (both genders), player in nml_hld_014. Sudden realization/surprise; works for both.

rows.en: Next!
Y-yes...
How about this!

This is all the rage these days, right?
What was it called......
Right! It's that "moe" thing, isn't it?
rows.notes: Both genders. moe kept as the otaku loanword (maid outfit, c07976).

rows.en: Well?! Are you feeling the moe?

It suits you really well, and I do feel
the moe, but...
Isn't that just cosplay at this point...?

Senpai, I'll come along with you,
so how about we go buy some clothes
together now...
Ugh... I'm counting on you......
rows.notes: Both genders. Klan relies on the player.

rows.en:
(Klan-senpai's road to becoming a grown woman
looks like it's going to be a rough one...)

(Still, where did Klan-senpai even buy
a China dress and a maid outfit...?)
rows.notes: Male. chaina-fuku = China dress (the Nyan-Nyan uniform).

rows.en:
(Klan-senpai called me out, saying there was
something she wanted me to see.
What could it be?)

(So, what kind of clothes
did Klan-senpai buy?)

Senpai, I'll come along with you,
so how about we go buy some clothes
together now...

(Klan-senpai's road to becoming a grown woman
looks like it's going to be a rough one...)

(Still, where did Klan-senpai even buy
a China dress and a maid outfit...?)

(Classes are over, and all that's left
is to go home. Where should I stop off
on the way today...)

Oh, if it isn't \p.
Heading home now?
Klan-senpai? What are you doing at Mihoshi...
Wait, why are you dressed like that?!
Hm? Dressed like what, exactly?
I mean that Nyan-Nyan China dress!

Ah, this?
It's surprisingly easy to move in,
so I've taken a liking to wearing it lately.
Well? It suits me after all, doesn't it?
Yes, very much...

(It does suit you, but you still look
exactly like a Nyan-Nyan waitress,
Klan-senpai...)

(Classes are over, and all that's left
is to go home. Where should I stop off
on the way today...)
(Klan-senpai's late...)

(She said she bought a new swimsuit and wanted
me to check it out, so we promised to hang out
on the artificial island......)
rows.notes: Both genders. jinkoutou = the artificial island (terms.json); the scene later calls it Island 3.

rows.en: Sorry I'm late, kid.
rows.notes: Male only (female variant is c08027). shounen = boy/kid.

rows.en:
Oh, Klan-senpai...
No, it's no proble......
rows.notes: Both genders. Cut off mid-word, as the Japanese.

rows.en: Why did you come here macronized?!

I told you I wanted you to see
my new swimsuit, didn't I?

Well, yes, but...
I thought you meant your Micronian swimsuit.
So, how do I look in my swimsuit?
O-of course it looks good on you...
Mm, good to hear.

(When she macronizes, a lot of her parts
get bigger, after all...)

Now then, we came all the way to Island 3.
Let's play till we drop.

Okay!
Wait, how are we supposed to play?

Are you an idiot? We came to the sea.
We could race each other swimming or play
beach volleyball. There's plenty to do.
Well, that's true, but...

Let's see... How about beach volleyball first?
Try and take my killer serve!
Um, Klan-senpai...

If I play beach volleyball with you
at Zentradi size, Senpai, I think I'd...
actually die......?
Ah?!

And here I went to the trouble
of macronizing. Honestly...
Sorry, Klan-senpai...

Well, there's no point in coming to the sea
with you if we can't play together.
Today we play until we can't move~!!
Klan-senpai... I can't go on......
Wiped out after just this? Pathetic.
You've just got too much energy, Senpai...
Fine, I'll let you off the hook for today.
Th-thank you...

Next time you won't get off this lightly,
so get yourself in shape!
Right, let's head home.

(I never expected Klan-senpai to show up
macronized, so that really surprised me...)

(Well, in the end I got to have fun with
Micronian-sized Klan-senpai, so I guess
today was a good day.)
(Klan-senpai's late...)
Sorry I'm late.

(When she macronizes, a lot of her parts
get bigger, after all...)
Well, that's true, but...

If I play beach volleyball with you
at Zentradi size, Senpai, I think I'd...
actually die......?

(I never expected Klan-senpai to show up
macronized, so that really surprised me...)

(Well, in the end I got to have fun with
Micronian-sized Klan-senpai, so I guess
today was a good day.)

Come on, let's play till we drop again today!
\p!
Too bad for you, though, \p.
Huh? What is?

Today I came Micronian-sized for your sake,
but that means you didn't get to see
my knockout body, right?
rows.notes: Both genders. naisu badi = knockout body.

rows.en:
Next time we get the chance,
I'll come macronized!

...But then we couldn't play together,
could we?
Hm, now that you mention it...

Dammit, and here I wanted to show off
my knockout body to you again...

(She doesn't have to be so bitter
about something like that...)
Oh well. Let's hurry up and play!

uncertain: c07995 shounen rendered 'kid' (Klan addressing the male player; the female branch has no address, c08027).
c07994 says the artificial island, c08005 says Island 3; kept both as written.
c08004/c08028 'iron na bubun ga ookiku naru' kept as the innuendo ('a lot of her parts get bigger').
c07969-c07971 moe kept as a loanword.
